author: Durk
install_msg: SentimentFilter installed. The bot owner must set an OpenRouter key with `[p]set api openrouter api_key,<key>`, then use `[p]sentimentfilter addchannel #channel`. Existing MessageFilter sentiment channels are imported automatically.
name: SentimentFilter
short: Delete negative or hostile messages using TypeSafe Jev
description: Removes complaints and hostility toward people in chosen channels, judged by TypeSafe Jev 1.13 through OpenRouter. The rule is configurable per server. Supports timeouts, logging, a silent mode, and SocialCredit integration.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store user data. Messages sent in filtered channels are sent to OpenRouter and TypeSafe for classification.
